summary:
Fixed the ioctl validation bug in [src/ioctl_handler.c](/app/src/ioctl_handler.c:40). The handlers now reject NULL value buffers, zero/oversized lengths, and invalid key lengths before copying. `SET_CONFIG` also rejects claimed lengths larger than the actual bounded string length, preventing the oversized `value_len` over-read.

Verification passed:

```text
./test.sh
PASS: IOCTL handler correctly validates all inputs
```

Only source change is `src/ioctl_handler.c`. The `src/*.o` and `src/devctl` files are regenerated build outputs from the test script.
